English:
Your cooking tastes like
it came out of a horse's ass.

Hah, mine? It's like fine wine
compared to *someone else's*.

Oh, shut up already! Everyone has their
strong and weak points, so who cares anyway?

But you'll never land a
husband if you can't cook, will you?

Hmph! You know what? I'll
just get one who can do it for me!
